 MP POLICE DRIVER RECRUITMENT 2026 
 MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026, Apply Online for 1,000 Posts
 MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026 offers 1,000 Constable Driver vacancies for male candidates. The online application window is from 15 October to 29 October 2026. Applicants must meet the prescribed educational and age criteria and hold a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle Driving Licence. Khushi Priya 17 Oct, 2026 Share

 MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026 has been announced by the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB), Bhopal, for Constable Driver positions under the Police Headquarters, Home (Police) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. A total of 1,000 vacancies are available for eligible male candidates.
 The online application process started on 15 October 2026, and eligible candidates can submit their forms until 29 October 2026. Applicants must fulfil the prescribed educational qualifications, possess a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle Driving Licence and satisfy the applicable age requirements. The recruitment process includes an online written examination, a Physical Efficiency Test (PET), document verification and a qualifying driving trade test.

 MP Police Driver Eligibility Criteria 2026
 Candidates must be Indian citizens and meet the educational, driving licence, age and other conditions specified for the recruitment. The posts are open only to male candidates.
 Educational Qualification
 The minimum educational requirement differs according to the candidate's category.
 Category 
 Required Qualification 
 UR/SC/OBC 
 Class 10 pass under the 10+2 system, Higher Secondary or an equivalent examination from a recognised board or institution 
 ST 
 Class 8 pass or equivalent 
 In addition to the educational qualification, candidates must hold a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle Driving Licence. Qualifying in the practical driving trade test is also compulsory.
 Madhya Pradesh Domicile Requirements
 Candidates who are not permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh can apply only for Unreserved Open vacancies. They cannot claim the reservation or age-relaxation benefits available to eligible Madhya Pradesh domicile candidates.

 MP Police Driver Selection Process 2026
 The selection process consists of two main stages. Candidates must qualify in the relevant tests and complete document verification to be considered for final selection.
 Stage 1: Online written examination.
 Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET), document verification and practical driving trade test.
 MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026 Apply Online Direct Link
 Candidates interested in MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026 can submit their applications online through the official MP Online portal. The application window is open from 15 October to 29 October 2026. Applicants should complete the form, pay the applicable examination fee and save the submitted application for future reference.

 How to Apply for MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026
 Eligible candidates must submit their applications online through the MP Online portal. They should keep their personal details, educational information and required documents ready before starting the application process.
 Follow these steps to apply:
 Visit the official MP Online website at www.mponline.gov.in .
 Navigate to the Citizen Services section.
 Select the MPESB/ESB application link.
 Open the MP Police Constable Driver Recruitment 2026 application.
 Read the examination instructions and recruitment rulebook carefully.
 Complete the required Aadhaar-based registration.
 Enter the requested personal, educational and category details.
 Upload the prescribed photograph and provide the necessary information.
 Pay the applicable examination fee and portal charges.
 Submit the completed application form.
 Save the online application number for future reference and admit card access.

 MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026 FAQs
 How many vacancies are available under MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
 A total of 1,000 Constable Driver vacancies have been announced, including 200 posts in the Special Armed Force and 800 posts in the District Police Force or other forces outside the Special Armed Force. What is the last date to apply for MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
 The last date to submit the online application is 29 October 2026. What is the educational qualification for MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
 UR, SC and OBC candidates must have passed Class 10 or an equivalent examination, while ST candidates must have passed Class 8 or an equivalent examination. All candidates must also possess a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle Driving Licence. What is the age limit for MP Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
 The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age is 33 years for unreserved male candidates from Madhya Pradesh, EWS male candidates and male candidates from other states. Applicable relaxations are available for specified categories under the recruitment rules. When will the MP Police Driver written examination be conducted?
 The written examination is scheduled to begin on 4 January 2027. The online test will consist of 100 questions carrying 100 marks, with a duration of two hours and no negative marking. Have questions about your prep?
